verdict.rationale: Mastra is a TypeScript framework deployable to Node.js, Bun, Deno, or Cloudflare and can be self-hosted or integrated into any Node.js-compatible server, which implies it runs headlessly outside any UI (mastra-docs-9, mastra-docs-18, mastra-docs-11). However, there is no explicit documentation or example of running Mastra in a CI pipeline, no CLI-for-automation reference, and no GitHub Actions/CI integration guide. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline example, headless/automation-specific docs, evidence of scripted non-interactive execution.
